content.text:
`limit` and `offset`.

They are optional integer query parameters used for pagination: `limit` caps the number of voices returned, and `offset` skips that many entries.

[Parameters](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/audio/voices#operation-list_voices_v1_audio_voices_get)
